queries.prompt: Spring GraphQL selection set이 넓어지면서 p95가 늘 때 resolver별 DB roundtrip과 DataLoader batch size를 어떻게 계측해?
queries.reformulated_query: Spring GraphQL resolver fan out N+1 DataLoader batch size DB roundtrip p95 selection set
queries.rationale: 일반 JPA fetch plan보다 GraphQL resolver/DataLoader 관측 경계가 primary다.

queries.prompt: GraphQL DataLoader cache를 request 밖으로 넓히거나 request 전체를 긴 transaction으로 감싸면 어떤 권한, 신선도, connection hold 문제가 생겨?
queries.reformulated_query: GraphQL DataLoader cache scope request transaction boundary authorization freshness connection hold time
queries.rationale: GraphQL DoS 방어보다 DataLoader cache scope와 transaction boundary가 primary다.
